Allergen introduction

Potato nut dumplings

Magvas nudli

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Try one tree nut at a time, the first taste in the morning, on a day your child is well. Once that nut is tolerated, keep offering it a few times a week. Peanut still needs its own foods.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 150 g potato (boiled and mashed; no wheat flour and no egg)
  • 1 tsp smooth almond butter or smooth walnut butter (one nut only, mixed into the dough; not peanut and not a spoonful on the side)

Allergens

tree nut

Method

  1. Boil the potato until very soft, then mash it with no salt and no flour.
  2. Stir in one teaspoon of one smooth nut butter, either almond or walnut, not both.
  3. Shape small soft dumplings with wet hands.
  4. Boil them until they are hot and soft all through.
  5. Serve the dumpling, not a dry nut coating and not a spoon of nut butter.

Adjusted

Dry nut coatings and whole nuts were the hazard. This does not replace peanut.

Mix one smooth nut butter into soft potato dumplings, almond or walnut, one nut at a time, and boil them. Do not roll them in dry ground nuts or serve thick nut butter on a spoon.
